label: About
title: About The Dove Lit Against the Night Canopy
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from a saved source, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: a visible mark in the scene opens the real source that shaped the day.

This edition began with one saved post, @adonixleen: @adonixleen: fruit dove photo (no caption). Its image from pbs.twimg.com set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became The Dove Lit Against the Night Canopy: Nocturnal flash-lit canopy void: a plump white fruit dove hunched in the left third, facing left, crimson cap glowing, sage-grey wing feathers ruffled. One dark twig slices diagonally across its shoulder and the full canvas. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped the source to dense scaled magenta undertail plume below the white body.
